Build a basin from flow data and a watershed (given or delineated)

Source: R/basin.R
wsva_basin.Rd

Build a basin from flow data and a watershed (given or delineated)

Usage

wsva_basin(
  flow,
  polygon = NULL,
  outlet = NULL,
  id = NULL,
  name = NULL,
  area_km2 = NULL,
  delineation = "auto",
  state = NULL
)

Arguments

flow

Standard flow table (flow_usgs(), flow_cdss(), flow_from_df(), flow_from_csv()).

polygon

Optional sf watershed. If NULL, the watershed is delineated upstream of outlet with delineate_basin().

outlet

Optional c(lon, lat); default from the flow metadata.

id, name

Optional; default from the flow metadata.

area_km2

Reference drainage area for converting flow to mm/day. Default: the reported area in the flow metadata, else the published GAGES-II / USGS area when the station has a USGS id, else the delineated area.

delineation, state

Passed to delineate_basin().

Value

A wsva_basin.
